Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Buddy Hield?

Buddy Hield is 33 years old.

Where was Buddy Hield born?

Buddy Hield was born in Freeport, Bahamas.

When was Buddy Hield born?

Buddy Hield was born on December 17, 1992.

How tall is Buddy Hield?

Buddy Hield is 6-4 (193 cm) tall.

How much does Buddy Hield weigh?

Buddy Hield weighs 220 lbs (99 kg).

Is Buddy Hield in the Hall of Fame?

Buddy Hield is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Buddy Hield drafted?

Buddy Hield was drafted by New Orleans Pelicans, 1st round (6th pick, 6th overall), 2016 NBA Draft.

What position does Buddy Hield play?

Shooting Guard and Small Forward.

What is Buddy Hield's net worth?

Buddy Hield has made at least $122,089,603 playing professional basketball.

How much does Buddy Hield make?

Buddy Hield made $24,701,834 in 2021.

How many rings does Buddy Hield have?

Buddy Hield has won 0 championships.

What is Buddy Hield's Instagram account?

Buddy Hield is on Instagram at buddylove242.

What schools did Buddy Hield attend?

Buddy Hield attended Sunrise Christian Academy in Bel Aire, Kansas and Oklahoma.

What are Buddy Hield's nicknames?

Buddy Love, Buddy Fresh, Buddy Buckets are nicknames for Buddy Hield.
